create_sawyer_mocap_env: create a SawyerMocapBase subclass to initialize a MuJoCo Sawyer robot environment with mocap XYZ control
get_endeff_position: get the end effector position of the Sawyer robot hand from the simulation data
compute_tcp_center: compute the center of mass between the left and right gripper fingers of the Sawyer robot
save_and_restore_env_state: save and restore the full simulation state including joint and mocap positions for the Sawyer environment
compute_gripper_caging_reward: compute a caging reward signal for the Sawyer gripper based on pad positions, object proximity, and gripper effort
